classification: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL (specialist entity-repair continuation). Not PAPER-FAITHFUL.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-26: after the standardized 2v2 foundation, the next stage is the entity-repair continuation for pi_A and pi_B with a fresh spec and fresh registered seeds, using the same repair methodology as the canonical 4v4/6v6 pipeline.
FREEZE_PRECONDITIONS: both standardized foundation finals exist, pass the foundation verification checklist and are committed; their sha256 are written into SOURCE_CHECKPOINTS below
train_specialist_scale.py enforces Rule 9 at training time (--experiment-id, registered RESERVED block, no prior run of the seed) -- landed only after the pi_B foundation process had loaded its code
the block below is reserved through experiments/seed_registry.py allocate, and SEEDS is filled from that reservation
a 2v2 entity-repair warm-start smoke (smoke seed family, --load-path + --entity-repair-enabled) completed, proving the path builds, warm-starts, trains, saves and reloads at N=2
SMOKE_DONE_2026_09_26: seed 99900203, CPU, 5,000 steps, --load-path final_smoke_pi_A_specialist_2v2.zip: exit 0; run_manifest entity_repair_enabled=True, live_pole_attestation_passed=True, live hash da87ea17... (certified A); final checkpoint reloads with 5 entity_encoder.* tensors in model_state_dict. Output: artifacts/scale_2v2_specialists/smoke_pi_A_specialist_2v2_entity_repair_launch_smoke/ (non-scientific).
STAGE: canonical lineage step 2 of: 1M base specialist (anchor OFF) -> entity-repair continuation -> split pi_D (k=1, N' teacher) -> Separated crossover -> CD dataset -> distilled suite arms. This spec authorizes step 2 ONLY.

RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_entity_repair.warm_start: --load-path <the standardized 2v2 foundation final> (weight initialization only: warm_start_reset_progress=True, global_step from 0, fresh optimizer)
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_entity_repair.everything_else: unchanged from the foundation run of the same policy (same R.POLICIES defaults, opponent pool A=[OP6] / B=[OP7], certified pole handoff); only N differs from the 4v4 reference
RECIPE_identical_to_4v4_entity_repair.resolved_config_check: the launch's own run_config is diffed against the 4v4 entity-repair run of the same policy; permitted differences: scale, run identity (seed, run_tag, paths, load_path), progress bar, per-team-size effective_lr, and PPOConfig fields added after the 4v4 run at inert defaults

POLES.source: the sealed 2v2 certification, through pole_attestation.resolve_pole_genome -> certified_pole_genome

SOURCE_CHECKPOINTS.pre_launch_check: the launcher re-hashes each --load-path file and refuses on mismatch

SEEDS.class_rationale: same class as the foundation pair and the 6v6 entity-repair pair (SCALE_6V6_ENTITY_REPAIR_BASE_PAIR_V2_TRAINING)

LAUNCH.order: sequential on one GPU: A then B
LAUNCH.crash_recovery: periodic checkpoints every 100,000 steps; resume with --resume <ckpt.zip> (same --experiment-id)
LAUNCH.launcher: artifacts/scale_2v2_specialists/run_std_entity_repair_detached.ps1 -- check-only by default, -Launch to train; every decision via experiments/frozen_launch_guard.py; runs LAUNCH verbatim
LAUNCH.preflight: powershell -File artifacts/scale_2v2_specialists/run_std_entity_repair_detached.ps1  (no -Launch) must log CHECK-ONLY PASS first

DONE_WHEN: both final checkpoints exist; each run_manifest records live_pole_attestation_passed=True with the certified hash, entity_repair_enabled=True, warm_start_from = the pinned foundation final, and seed_registry = this block
each checkpoint carries entity_* parameters (the repair is present in the saved object, not only in the config)
the registry block is set SPENT after both runs are verified
NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: the split pi_D, any crossover, dataset collection or distillation (each needs its own frozen spec and registered seeds)
any change to the entity-repair architecture or hidden size relative to 4v4
warm-starting from anything other than the pinned standardized foundation finals

AMENDMENT_AFTER_ABORTED_LAUNCH_2026_09_2.what_happened: While testing the detached launcher's uncommitted-spec guard, the real launcher was run. Its guard used `git diff --quiet HEAD -- <spec>`, which reports no change for an UNTRACKED file, so it passed and pi_A (seed 23200001) started training at 22:06:12Z from this spec before the spec was committed. Killed at ~12,016 of 1,000,000 steps; no checkpoint was written.
AMENDMENT_AFTER_ABORTED_LAUNCH_2026_09_2.rule_broken: no seed is spent before the governing spec is committed
remediation: aborted run preserved as artifacts/scale_2v2_specialists/pi_A_specialist_2v2_std_entity_repair_ABORTED_PREMATURE_LAUNCH_seed23200001 with ABORTED_PREMATURE_LAUNCH.json (INVALID_FOR_SCIENTIFIC_USE; 12,016 steps, manually killed, no checkpoint); its run_manifest stays on disk, so prior_training_uses keeps refusing 23200001

registry block STANDARDIZED_2V2_ENTITY_REPAIR_PAIR_TRAINING 23200001..23200002 RETIRED whole: retirement_reason=partial_block_contamination_from_premature_entity_repair_launch, used_seed=23200001, unused_but_retired_seed=23200002
fresh block STANDARDIZED_2V2_ENTITY_REPAIR_PAIR_TRAINING_V2 23300001..23300002 chosen by seed_registry next_free; SEEDS and LAUNCH below name it

launch decisions moved into experiments/frozen_launch_guard.py (tested in a temporary git repo: untracked / modified / staged / unfrozen spec, wrong or unregistered / SPENT / RETIRED / outside-block seed, wrong experiment id, already-trained seed, missing or mismatched warm start each REFUSE; committed clean frozen spec PASSES; reverting to the old `git diff HEAD` check turns the untracked case red)
launcher is check-only by default; training needs -Launch; preflight covers both policies before anything starts
AMENDMENT_AFTER_ABORTED_LAUNCH_2026_09_2.scientific_content_unchanged: recipe, warm-start checkpoints and their sha256, architecture, budget and poles are exactly as frozen; only the seed block changed

AMENDMENT_INFRA_RESTART_2026_09_26.what_happened: pi_A (seed 23300001, launched 22:13:38Z from 990f5d65) died at ~93k of 1,000,000 steps when Windows Update restarted the host (System event 1074, MoUsoCoreWorker.exe, 22:29:23Z). No checkpoint had been written (periodic interval 100,000), so --resume was impossible. pi_B never started.
AMENDMENT_INFRA_RESTART_2026_09_26.decision: PI, 2026-09-26: 'rerun' -- restart seed 23300001 from step 0 as a crash restart of the same run; the V2 block stays RESERVED (not retired)
AMENDMENT_INFRA_RESTART_2026_09_26.evidence: artifacts/scale_2v2_specialists/pi_A_specialist_2v2_std_entity_repair_ABORTED_INFRA_REBOOT_seed23300001/ (manifest, config, metrics, episode rows, ABORTED_INFRA_RESTART.json) + its logs; INVALID_FOR_SCIENTIFIC_USE
AMENDMENT_INFRA_RESTART_2026_09_26.mechanism: seed_registry.infra_restart_exempt: prior_training_uses skips a dead attempt only if it carries ABORTED_INFRA_RESTART.json naming the same seed with rerun_authorized and authorized_by, and no checkpoint *.zip exists under it (checked on disk). The premature-launch attempt (23200001) has no such marker and stays refused.
AMENDMENT_INFRA_RESTART_2026_09_26.unchanged: recipe, seeds (23300001, 23300002), LAUNCH commands, pinned warm-start checkpoints and hashes, poles
